fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a 1-second delay, '''Twitch''' becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} for a duration. Attacking or casting ''{{ai|Venom Cask|Twitch}}'' or ''{{ai|Contaminate|Twitch}}'' ends ''Ambush'' immediately.
fields.description2: During this time, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing enemy {{tip|champions}} within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.
fields.description3: Upon breaking stealth, '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.
fields.description4: When an enemy {{tip|champion}} dies while afflicted with ''{{ai|Deadly Venom|Twitch}}'', ''Ambush's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reset.
fields.notes:
* Entering stealth cancels '''Twitch's''' current basic attack.
* ''Ambush'' follows the same rules as stealth but he can still perform actions normally before entering {{tip|camouflage}}. Activating {{si|Recall}} during the 1-second delay allows him to {{tip|channel}} it while stealthed.
* If '''Twitch''' enters {{tip|stasis}} during the delay, he will gain the {{tip|camouflage}} after the stasis ends.
* Using a basic attack {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the stealth}} at the start of the attack windup.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
